$description: Chart colors (decision 0051): a fixed categorical order for charts with several series. A chart with one series uses the accent (primary). Text in a chart never wears these colors.

6.$description: Chart series 6 (green). Fixed order, never cycled; validated for color-blind separation on Orion surfaces.
